panels.description: Shows rate of execution for operations against the bucket.
panels.title: Bucket Operation Rate

panels.description: Shows ratio of errors compared to the total number of executed operations against the bucket.

targets.expr: sum by (job, operation) (rate(thanos_objstore_bucket_operation_failures_total{job=~"thanos-storegateway.*"}[$interval])) / sum by (job, operation) (rate(thanos_objstore_bucket_operations_total{job=~"thanos-storegateway.*"}[$interval]))

panels.title: Bucket Operation Errors

panels.description: Shows how long has it taken to execute operations against the bucket, in quantiles.

targets.expr: sum by (job, operation) (rate(thanos_objstore_bucket_operation_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"thanos-storegateway.*"}[$interval])) * 1  / sum by (job, operation) (rate(thanos_objstore_bucket_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"thanos-storegateway.*"}[$interval]))

panels.title: Bucket Operation Duration
